identity.name: Seamaster 300
identity.one_liner: The regular-production, vintage-styled Seamaster 300 that carries the broad-arrow hands and lollipop seconds hand of the 2015 Spectre limited edition into Omega's ongoing catalog.

narrative.story: The original Seamaster 300 launched in 1957 as Omega's dive-tool answer alongside the Speedmaster and Railmaster. Its broad-arrow-hands, lollipop-seconds design language returned in 2015 on the 233.32.41.21.01.001 Spectre limited edition, worn by Daniel Craig's Bond and built on the older caliber 8400. This reference is a distinct, non-limited follow-on that carries the same vintage look into regular production with a transparent caseback and the newer caliber 8912.
narrative.collector_notes: Do not confuse this reference with the 233.32.41.21.01.001 Spectre limited edition: same design language, different case reference, a solid Bond-medallion caseback on the LE versus a sapphire display back here, and caliber 8400 on the LE versus 8912 on this one.
